answer: The cipher of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The kernel holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
